Problems in a table or list (dark orange-red text)

Source: R/steps.R
kit_problems.Rd

A list of individual problems inside a step card, such as "還差：…" ("Still needed: …") or "這幾欄有問題" ("these columns have problems").

Usage

kit_problems(..., head = NULL, bullets = TRUE)

Arguments

...

One string (or tag) per problem.

head

Bold text in front, for example "還差：" ("Still needed:"); NULL shows nothing.

bullets

TRUE (default): one bullet per problem; FALSE: one per line, without bullets (for example when each line is already a full sentence, or already has its own numbering).

Value

<div class="kit-problems">; NULL when there are no problems.

Examples

kit_problems("第 2 列沒有選世代", "第 4 列的波次不是數字", head = "還差：")
#> <div class="kit-problems">
#>   <strong>還差：</strong>
#>   <ul>
#>     <li>第 2 列沒有選世代</li>
#>     <li>第 4 列的波次不是數字</li>
#>   </ul>
#> </div>
kit_problems("bsrs1：w1d5_1 和 w2d5_1 的分數範圍不同", bullets = FALSE)
#> <div class="kit-problems">
#>   <div>bsrs1：w1d5_1 和 w2d5_1 的分數範圍不同</div>
#> </div>
